notes.title: Witchdoctor
notes.content:
We are pleased to present the first large-scale update of the game Dungeons and Vampires!

There:

 fixed a significant part of the bugs that the players wrote in the discussions
 added a new character Witchdoctor, with his unique abilities
 new game mechanics - traps right on the floors
 monsters can see their HP
[/ list]
